title: HELIX Bridge: National Student Clearinghouse StudentTracker → ContinuingEducation

source_objects.description: One row per enrollment (or degree) found at another institution for each graduate you submitted. Columns include Requester Return Field, Record Found Y/N, College Code/Branch, College Name, College State, 2-year / 4-year, Public / Private, Enrollment Begin, Enrollment End, Enrollment Status, Class Level, Enrollment Major and CIP, Graduated?, Degree Title.

notes: Send the HELIX token (never SSN) in the Requester Return Field so results rejoin without a name match. The Clearinghouse returns data under your StudentTracker agreement; keep that agreement on file with the data sharing templates in govern/. Some students block release (FERPA) and come back as not found; that isn't evidence of no further study.
validate: Column names follow the StudentTracker detail report layout. Confirm against the file specification for your contract, since layouts are revised.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Deterministic UUID from Requester Return Field + College Code/Branch + Enrollment Begin.
Carries the HELIX token you sent. Resolve to HELIX Student.
Resolve to the HELIX Degree that put the graduate in the cohort you submitted.

Class Level codes (M masters, D doctoral, P postdoctorate, B bachelor's) and degree titles map to the HELIX values. Unknown levels -> postbaccalaureate. Rows at your own institution after graduation are continuing education too.
This is the OPEID-based school code. Crosswalk to IPEDS Unit ID with the IPEDS directory file.
Often blank; many schools don't report majors.
F -> full_time; Q, H, L -> part_time; A (leave), W (withdrawn), blank -> unknown.
